# Atom & Bits: Ian Harman

> Ian Harman is a founder-operator and advisor in Chattanooga, Tennessee. He gives leaders facing a hard growth decision the strategic insight and question depth to see what they are missing and where they need to go, usually in a 30-minute conversation or less. His deepest experience is in behavioral health and healthcare; his advisory work also spans manufacturing and health tech. Atom & Bits, LLC is his company.

Ian comes to each conversation curious and prepared: he researches the company first, then asks questions until the assumption, constraint, or person a plan has not accounted for is on the table. A first conversation leaves a leader with three things, whether or not they work together: what they are missing, the question worth answering first, and where to go next.

Inquiries sent through the contact form or by email get a reply within minutes. Ian's own agent drafts that first reply in his voice, and Ian reads every thread. Please do not send patient health information.

## Who it is for

- Founders, executives, and operating teams facing a hard growth decision: entering a market, deciding what to build, buy, change, or stop, or growing faster than the team that delivers the work.
- Behavioral health and healthcare companies, where Ian's experience runs deepest.
- Portfolio companies and investors who need product and technology judgment close to the business.

## Offers

- [30-minute strategic conversation](https://atomandbits.com/contact/): The starting point. Bring one decision; leave with what you are missing, the question worth answering first, and where to go next.
- [Product & AI assessment](https://atomandbits.com/ai-fit-review/): Two weeks on one product or workflow decision, ending in a recommendation with reasons and a 90-day plan someone can own. Fixed fee agreed before kickoff.
- [Agent workflow pilot](https://atomandbits.com/agent-workflows/): Test an AI agent on one repeated task with human review built in, and measure useful output, time saved, and the effort of using it.
- [Product & technology leadership](https://atomandbits.com/product-technology-leadership/): Lead product, technology, hiring, and delivery decisions with a team, with clear agreement on what Ian owns.

## Proof points

- [TheraMatch / TPN Match](https://atomandbits.com/work/theramatch/): Ian co-founded TheraMatch and led its sale to TPN.health. TheraMatch / TPN Match reached $1M ARR and 1M+ lives under care in less than 12 months.
- [One to One Health](https://atomandbits.com/work/one-to-one-health/): Ian designed and developed the initial AI infrastructure for clinical notes. Charting time fell from 22 to 17.5 minutes across all encounters, an average of 4.5 minutes saved per encounter.
- [Paragon Truss](https://atomandbits.com/work/paragon-truss/): Ian led the company's first enterprise deal, worth $500,000 in annual contract value.
- [BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee](https://atomandbits.com/work/bcbst/): Ian led digital products serving about 3.5 million members; digital adoption more than doubled and administrative costs fell by $500K+.
- [PerfectServe](https://atomandbits.com/work/perfectserve/): Ian built a new-market sales approach that brought in $3M+ in revenue.
- [TPN.health](https://atomandbits.com/work/tpn-match/): As VP, Provider Networks & Technology, Ian asked what invoicing payers directly was meant to achieve, which led to an internal claims filing and revenue capture platform.
